jobs.description:
Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics

jobs.occupation: Reach Truck Driver - Logent (Evergem / region Ghent, Belgium)
jobs.description:
• Safely operating reach trucks to maneuver, stack, retrieve, and store palletized goods in high-bay warehouse racks.  
•   
Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.
    
•   
Performing visual quality inspections on incoming goods, reporting discrepancies or damage promptly to the warehouse supervisor.
    
•   
Replenishing pick faces and staging inventory for order pickers to prevent bottlenecks.
    
•   
Maintaining clean aisles, adhering strictly to occupational safety protocols, and conducting daily pre-shift reach truck checks.
   
  
•   
You hold a valid reach truck driver certificate / license (reachtruckattest) and have hands-on driving experience.
    
•   
Fluent communication skills in English (working knowledge of Dutch is an asset) to ensure safety on the work floor and clear team communication.
    
•   
You have reliable personal transport (car, motorcycle, or electric bike) to reach our facility in Evergem independently, matching early/late or night shift schedules.
    
•   
You are available for a 2-shift rotation or a fixed night shift and align with our collective closure schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas/New Year holiday period).

As a Personal Assistant in the fashion industry, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure smooth and efficient operations. This role is based in Brussels and requires strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Description

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3+ years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Support the CEO and executive leadership team by ensuring the smooth coordination of administrative, organizational, marketing, and operational activities.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Description

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.
